Looking for a porta cabin in Mangalore? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Mangalore from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 350 km on the NH-75, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 2 to 4 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. It arrives ready to use, with no on-site construction.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Mangalore is served fully from Bangalore, and the relatively short coastal-ghat route keeps transit and freight low for a port city.

Why buyers in Mangalore choose SAMAN

Mangalore is a port, petrochemical, and education city on the Karnataka coast. New Mangalore Port, the MRPL refinery and the MSEZ petrochemical belt, the fishing harbour operations, the IT growth, and the steady campus and hospital construction â€” all of it needs movable, weather-tight workspace that holds up to coastal conditions. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or pouring a permanent slab for a temporary need.

The coast is the real test here. Mangalore gets one of the heaviest monsoons in India, and the salt air corrodes ordinary steel fast. Our frames are anti-rust treated, the roofs are sloped and sealed for heavy rain, and the panels are sealed against humidity. We build to order, sized for your site, finished in your colour, and fitted with the points and windows you need. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India. Explore our porta cabin options, built to this same standard.

Local industries in Mangalore that use porta cabins

Mangalore's demand is port, refinery, and coastal-construction driven:

  • New Mangalore Port, Panambur (575010) â€” freight and logistics operators use porta cabins as gate offices, weighbridge cabins, and supervisor rooms.
  • MRPL and the MSEZ petrochemical belt, Jokatte (575030) â€” refinery and chemical contractors use them as on-site project offices and security posts.
  • Baikampady Industrial Area (575011) â€” manufacturing and warehousing units use them as shift offices and store rooms.
  • NH-66 coastal corridor and Surathkal â€” construction and campus contractors use them as on-site offices that relocate as work moves along the coast.

For any site from Panambur to Baikampady, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated â€” important on the salt-air Mangalore coast
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with a steeper slope for Mangalore's heavy monsoon runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, sealed against rain and humidity

Sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For full construction detail and finish options, see the steel porta cabin product page â€” the build most Mangalore site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets for office use
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Glass front for a reception, gate, or weighbridge cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Sealed, anti-skid flooring for wet, humid coastal sites

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Mangalore depends on the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better and suits the coastal climate), the interior fit-out, and transport. The relatively short ghat route to Mangalore keeps freight moderate for a coastal city. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use â€” no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Mangalore

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Mangalore down the NH-75 ghat route â€” typically 2 to 4 days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base that drains well in the rain â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground â€” ready before delivery.

We deliver across coastal Karnataka and the wider South from the same factory. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also see our porta cabin in Madurai and porta cabin in Kochi pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Mangalore?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out, with moderate transport given the short ghat route from Bangalore. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Mangalore take?

Usually 2 to 4 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 350 km on the NH-75.

Do the cabins handle Mangalore's heavy monsoon and salt air?

Yes. The frames are anti-rust treated, the roof is sloped and sealed for heavy rain, and the panels and joinery are sealed against coastal humidity.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure â€” it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Mangalore

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
